title: The new Tal (Daniil Dubov)
post: They call him the new Tal… so why did he play THIS at a World Championship? #chess #dubov #magnuscarlsen #story #chessdrama

voice._name: Callum (ElevenLabs premade), eleven_v3 with audio tags in "say"

phrases.text: They call him the new Mikhail Tal.
phrases.say: [mysterious] They call him... the new Mikhail Tal.

phrases.text: So why did he play this at a World Championship?
phrases.say: [curious] So why did he play... this... at a World Championship?

phrases.text: Daniil Dubov. Like Tal, he throws pieces at your king.
phrases.say: Daniil Dubov. [mischievously] Like Tal, he throws pieces at your king.

phrases.text: Here, he gives up a rook...
phrases.say: Here, he gives up a rook...

phrases.text: and chases the king across the entire board.
phrases.say: [excited] and chases the king across the entire board!

phrases.text: He won the World Rapid title ahead of Magnus.
phrases.say: He won the World Rapid title... ahead of Magnus.

phrases.text: Then knocked Magnus out of a tournament. With checkmate.
phrases.say: Then knocked Magnus out of a tournament. [dramatic] With checkmate.

phrases.text: In 2021, he helped Magnus defend his title against a fellow Russian, Ian Nepomniachtchi.
phrases.say: In 2021, he helped Magnus defend his title... against a fellow Russian, Ian Nepomniachtchi.

phrases.text: Back home, he was accused of betrayal.
phrases.say: [serious] Back home, he was accused of betrayal.

phrases.text: Two years later, World Blitz. His opponent: Nepomniachtchi.
phrases.say: Two years later... World Blitz. His opponent: [mischievously] Nepomniachtchi.

phrases.text: Only knights. Twelve moves later, every piece is back home. Draw, in forty-two seconds.
phrases.say: Only knights. Twelve moves later... every piece is back home. [laughs] Draw, in forty-two seconds.

phrases.text: The arbiter's answer: zero points. For both.
phrases.say: The arbiter's answer: [serious] zero points. For both.

phrases.text: Without that zero, he'd have tied Magnus for first.
phrases.say: [sighs] Without that zero... he'd have tied Magnus for first.

phrases.text: Eleven days later, online, they did the knight dance again. And Dubov won that tournament.
phrases.say: Eleven days later, online... they did the knight dance again. [laughs] And Dubov won that tournament.

phrases.text: New Tal, or the biggest troll in chess? Rate him from one to ten.
phrases.say: [curious] New Tal... or the biggest troll in chess? Rate him from one to ten.
